description: This source file defines a custom JSON converter for java.util.Date objects, implementing methods to parse date strings into Date instances and serialize Date objects into ISO 8601 formatted strings, using Jackson library and integrated as a Spring component.

classes.name: DateJsonConverter
classes.description: A Jackson JsonConverter implementation for java.util.Date, converting ISO8601 date strings to Date objects and vice versa, registered as a Spring component.

methods.name: convertToObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON string representing a date in ISO_INSTANT format and converts it into a java.util.Date object.

methods.name: convertToJson
methods.description: Serializes a java.util.Date object into an ISO 8601 string in JSON format.

methods.name: convertedType
methods.description: Returns the class type this converter handles, which is java.util.Date.
